resources.string: Allows this app to lock the screen when opened.
Allow Lock Screen to use device-admin access. This is required to lock the screen. You can remove this access in Android settings before uninstalling the app.
Open this app to lock the screen. The first time, Android will ask you to allow device-admin access.
Device-admin access was not enabled. Enable it to let this app lock the screen.
Android could not lock the screen. Confirm device-admin access is still enabled.
